description: Intent i004 (branch vm-shared-desc-rereads, snapshot s01) concluded with an evidence-backed negative result. Searched only snapshots/s01 (a modern tree with drivers/vhost, drivers/vdpa, drivers/virtio, drivers/net/virtio_net.c, drivers/net/tun.c, net/vmw_vsock). 11 candidates triaged with exact line evidence; zero findings. Key results: (1) drivers/vhost/vhost.c:2878 vhost_get_vq_desc_n copies each guest descriptor once into a stack local via vhost_get_desc->vhost_copy_from_user (helper at vhost.c:1579-1582); all flags/addr/len checks, translate_desc, log writes, and the READ_ONCE(desc->next) chain walk consume only that local; avail idx/head fetched once via get_user with '(u16)(avail_idx - last_avail_idx) > vq->num' and 'head >= vq->num' checks on the same locals. (2) get_indirect (vhost.c:2703) copies each indirect entry into a fresh local via copy_from_iter_full with loop bounded by the local count. (3) __vringh_iov (vringh.c:332) and __vringh_get_head (vringh.c:38-75) single-copy descriptors and avail entries with head bounds check on the local. (4) vhost_net_build_xdp (net.c:712) reads gso csum fields only from a kernel-private copy_from_iter buffer. (5) vhost_scsi (scsi.c:1140/1216) copy_from_iter_full's the request header once; lun/target/tag/cdb/prot_bytes from the same local. (6) vhost vsock TX (vsock.c:116) writes host-built headers into once-translated iovs. (7) virtio_net.c receive_mergeable/xdp/xsk paths read hdr->num_buffers once into a local (2272/2383/1241) and loop on it; re-reads exist only in pr_debug. (8) VDUSE write_iter copies responses once into a stack struct and validates reserved/request_id on the local (vduse_dev.c:419). (9) vhost_vdpa get/set_config copy the off/len header once and validate the local (vdpa.c:340-365). (10) virtio_mem_init snapshots config once via virtio_cread_le into vm-> state (virtio_mem.c:2846). (11) tun_get_user/__tun_vnet_hdr_get copy the vnet header once into a stack struct and consume the local (tun_vnet.h:120-151, tun.c:1816); virtio_net_hdr_tnl_to_skb re-reads fields but only from caller-owned kernel copies. Limitations: bounded to the vm-shared-desc-rereads surface listed; vdpa vendor drivers, virtio_balloon/input, vringh callers outside drivers/vhost, Xen/KVM paravirt, and vmw_vmci were not exhaustively audited; conclusions are static single-fetch analysis with no runtime race reproducer. Structured artifact: agent-state/findings/i004.json (execution_status complete, snapshots_checked ["s01"], findings []).
